method: Same-design replica of the home page: chrome interactions rebuilt natively in header/footer blocks, client-only islands re-implemented in hero/logo-ticker/tabs/steps blocks, YouTube kept as a click-to-load nocookie facade, newsletter UI rebuilt without a backend, tags carried over via scripts/martech.js with every contract part OFF. Probed on the published origin at 1440 and 360 (stardust/.work/dynamics/probes/).

features.verifiedBy: 1440: 4 submenu toggles open one panel each — platform 777x213/9 links, solutions 540x369/11, developers 600x411/16, resources 200x300/8; Escape closes (0 open after). 360: hamburger sets data-site-nav-open, drawer 360x667 with 47 links
